text:
asha: kicking off account bootstrap for new org 'redwood-north-hybrid' — target zones: north-eu1 + north-us2. need checklist + quota asks. anyone have the latest cross-cloud playbook? :coffee:
kevin: I sketched a trimmed checklist for this last week, will paste essentials below. main ask: GPU quota (A100/V100), external NAT IPs, and egress limits.
samir: pinging billing to get a billing account prelinked. also we should lock tag taxonomy: cost_center:inference, env:prod, team:infra.
asha: perfect. include IAM roles we need for service accounts (k8s deployer, node-provisioner, vpn-manager).
kevin: minimal IAM snippet I use for project bootstrap:
```json
{
  "bindings": [
    {"role": "roles/compute.viewer", "members": ["serviceAccount:k8s-deployer@REDACTED.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]},
    {"role": "roles/iam.serviceAccountUser", "members": ["serviceAccount:k8s-deployer@REDACTED.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]}
  ]
}
```
rachel: for Azure we'll need Contributor on RG for infra nodes + specific role for aks-managed identity. also request quota for NCv3/NDv3 families.
asha: suggested quota request template (copy/paste to cloud support):
```
Subject: Quota increase request for Redwood Inference - Org: redwood-north-hybrid
Body:
Hello,
Please increase the following quotas for project REDWOOD-PROD-xxx in region <region>:
- GPUs: +40 A100 (or equivalent)
- CPUs: +320 cores
- External IP addresses: +24
- VPC network egress (Gbps): increase from 2 -> 10
Reason: production inference fleet for low-latency regional serving.
Requested by: infra@redwood.ai
ETA: needed in 7 business days for staged rollout.
Thanks,
Infra ops
```
samir: add note to ask cloud teams to exempt from preemptible instance limits (we need reserved capacity) and request a soft limit for sustained instances.
kevin: networking checklist: create shared VPC, enable Private Google Access, set up NAT gateway with high-ports, enable flow logs, add prefixes and route filters. Also IP tagging: tag instances with 'nat-zone:<zone>' for egress accounting.
asha: here's the tag naming convention I want documented for billing + RBAC: cost_center:inference, cost_owner:team-infra, environment:prod/staging, deployment:dedicated/private, region:north-eu1.
rachel: on Azure, add tags as resource tags and enforce via policy. I'll draft the policy snippet.
kevin: quick k8s service-account names to create during bootstrap: `redwood-node-sa`, `cache-proxy-sa`, `model-runner-sa`, `batch-workload-sa`. Make sure they map to least-privilege roles.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INFRA-1245 to track quota requests + tagging autopolicy. Assignees: samir, rachel.
asha: escalation path: if quota not approved in 5 business days -> escalate to cloud-eng leads + open support call. Add cloud-sales contact for faster lift if necessary.
samir: also raise request for project-level KMS key with rotation and HSM-backed envelope encryption. put key in a shared crypto-project.
kevin: ops checklist summary (short):
- create org + billing link
- setup shared VPC and subnets per-region
- request GPU quotas per region (A100/NC/ND variants)
- reserve external IPs and provision NATs
- create service accounts + IAM bindings
- apply tags & label policies
- enable audit logging + long-term sink to BigQuery/Blob store
- request KMS key + HSM if required
- run small capacity validation: 3 nodes with model-runner image -> smoke test

rachel: validation tests to run after quotas granted: GPU allocation, NVLINK health, nvidia-smi sanity, kernel driver checks, egress throughput test (iperf), and cost estimator run (per-token cost baseline).
asha: perfect. can someone draft the support ticket for GCP + Azure with the template above? I'll handle AWS if needed.
samir: drafting GCP ticket now, will paste here in 10m and include quota numbers per zone.
kevin: i'll add the IAM policy PR and tag enforcement policy.
asha: thanks team — let's try to get all quota asks in by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
